title: Older transfemoral amputee, vascular etiology, limited community ambulator
referral_text: Patient P-2210, 71-year-old female, 68 kg, 162 cm. Left transfemoral amputation 6 months ago due to peripheral arterial disease. Residual limb short (approx. 25% of femur), healed, some fragile skin over the distal end. Type 2 diabetes, well controlled (HbA1c 6.8%), mild hypertension. Currently ambulates with a walker indoors and short distances outside (to the mailbox, around the garden). Goal: walk safely at home and short community distances, avoid falls. Lives with her daughter. Some reduced grip strength in both hands.
